evidence: Existing six high-response audit image IDs from verified plans. Old per-unit peak exclusions inherited. No new images or inference.
interpretation: Consistency of sampled strong response pairs, not recall, specificity against nonresponding images, full-bank latent semantics, fragmentation, or semantic-fit audit against a locked description.
limitations: Previously inspected pool; some audit examples already inspected in the old study.
AI-assisted exploratory review, method and old-status hidden in sheets; not a blinded independent human study.
Different native capacities and original training assignments remain.
Three pairs per group have substantial sampling uncertainty; groups and pairs share images and are not independent model runs.
No model-run significance claim or SD from one model run.
No Capture or Patch AP endpoint.
missingness: All native groups stay in the denominator. Missing slots/images and unreadable pairs contribute unknown [0,1], not an invented zero. Report judged yes/no/unclear counts and available pairs.
pairs: Deterministically hash-shuffle six planned slots per unit, pair adjacent slots into three disjoint pairs. Short plans retain missing slots, not replacements.
primary: Per native group: count semantic yes/3 and (yes+unclear)/3, averaged equally over ALL native groups. These are unresolved-pair bounds on this finite fixed-pair metric, not confidence intervals or bounds on all possible images.
purpose: Include every native group without conditioning on an interpretable description.
relationship: NEW exploratory post-hoc endpoint selected after seeing old results; never replace or revise old locked descriptions or claim preregistration.
reviewer: Codex AI reviewers, individually identified; previous user authorization for parallel review persists
secondary: Determinate-pair yes/(yes+no), clearly conditional; calibration-activity weighted bounds; native partitions; old-disposition breakdown; visual-property bounds.
semantic_no: Responding content is visible and semantically different, with no common specific meaning. Mere outdoor/background/thing/animal/furniture umbrella, same color, brightness, orientation or generic edge is not a semantic yes.
semantic_unclear: Missing crop/slot, unreadable responding content, competing meanings with no dominant support, or genuinely uncertain relation. Do not force a yes or no.
semantic_yes: Dominant responding content in BOTH views supports the SAME specific semantic meaning: basic-level object, identifiable part/action/scene relation, or named material/region such as grass, sky, water, wall, floor. State the shared meaning. Judge actual outlined locations with context, not an incidental object elsewhere.
spatial: Show original crop with POSITIVE positions among its strongest four of196 native response positions outlined. Never outline zero/negative filler positions. Frozen signed score arrays are unchanged. No object masks.
visual_yes: Separately, a specific shared visual property (color/material/texture/form) is visible at responding positions. State it. This is secondary and never substituted for semantic yes.
